method: One pinned Ubuntu fixed H.264 NVENC host uses native MIT-SHM readback. A single pinned Mint viewer uses VA-API download and CPU X11 RGB. Only JWM_REMOTE_X11_PREPARE changes. Worker native preparation and presenter whole draw-call time are separate software measurements. Worker timings are recorded when the UI receives the completed job, including obsolete or failed jobs. Prepared counts successful packing, submitted counts valid prepared draws, and fallback counts a synchronous draw after failed or obsolete viewport preparation. Stale counts discarded source or geometry work. These events can cross reporting windows. Existing completion includes X11 events and upload/copy fences; quantiles summarize whole windows. Each visible marker score uses 60 seconds after 30 seconds warmup. The pair is diagnostic. These view-only trials measure cadence and presenter work; software input response is outside their scope.

viewer_build.scope: SHA manifest recorded for the benchmark release binary. Cargo tests ran in separate test executables. The source pins describe the recorded build and exclude subsequent worktree test changes.
